content.text: The aggregation pipeline processes documents through a series of stages. Each stage transforms the documents.

content.definition: A single transformation in an aggregation pipeline, like $match (filter) or $group (aggregate).

content.text: Put $match and $sort early in the pipeline so MongoDB can use indexes.

questions.question: Which stage filters documents in an aggregation pipeline?
questions.explanation: $match filters documents, equivalent to a WHERE clause in SQL.

faq.a: Yes. db.collection.aggregate([{ $match: query }]) is equivalent to find(query), but aggregation is more powerful for transformations.

examples: Building a sales leaderboard with $group and $sort
